text: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4   Issued at 08:30 PM 27 October 2025 Light to Moderate rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #ZamboangaSibugay(Payao, Talusan, Olutanga, Alicia), #SultanKudarat(Lebak), #MaguindanaoDelSur(SouthUpi, Ampatuan, DatuHofferAmpatuan, ShariffAguak), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Labason, Liloy), #DavaoOccidental(JoseAbadSantos), #LanaoDelSur(Picong, Calanogas, Malabang, Pagayawan, Pualas, Marogong) and #LanaoDelNorte(Nunungan) within the next 1-2 hours. Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #ZamboangaDelSur(Margosatubig, VincenzoA.Sagun, Dimataling, Pitogo, Tabina) and #DavaoOccidental(Sarangani) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas. All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates. Marilog, Davao City kaninang alas 9:00 ng umaga, Mayo 8, 2025. A landslide occurred at 12:30 AM in San Ramon, San Ricardo, Southern Leyte, on July 13, 2025, resulting in one person missing and one injured.  The incident took place in Barangay San Ramon, a village located 40 kilometers from the town proper.According to reports the landslide was triggered by prolonged heavy rains.  The missing person was identified as Dador Moscosa, a foreman for 888 ACY Construction, the company working on a viaduct project in the area.  #SanRicardoLandslide #SouthernLeyteAlert #LeyteLandslide #LandslidePH #PHWeatherAlert ctto A landslide occurred at 12:30 AM in San Ramon, San Ricardo, Southern Leyte, on July 13, 2025, resulting in one person missing and one injured.

Meet Wanhan, the one-handed fighter who refused to give up.  After what looked like a hit-and-run, this dog dragged himself through an open gate. He was weak, crying, bleeding, and looking for safety. I wanted to give him a fighting chance… X-rays & labs revealed the extent of his injuries: - Broken pelvic bone - Burst bladder (his abdomen was full of urine) - Anemia and infection Emergency surgery was his only chance. His bladder has been repaired, and he’s now slowly recovering.
